items.title: Stocks fall on Wall Street as oil prices jump back above $100 a barrel after Iran war escalates
items.summary: Stocks fell on Wall Street Wednesday as the price of crude oil rose back above $100 a barrel amid further escalation in the U.S. war with Iran.  Nearly every sector within the benchmark S&P 500 lost ground, but oil companies pushed higher.  Oil prices drove much of the action on Wall Street.
